instruments.title: Add Noteikumi par aizdomīgu darījumu ziņojumu un sliekšņa deklarācijas iesniegšanas kārtību un saturu, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 550 of 17 August 2021 on how suspicious transaction reports and threshold declarations are filed with the Financial Intelligence Unit

titles.lv: Noteikumi par aizdomīgu darījumu ziņojumu un sliekšņa deklarācijas iesniegšanas kārtību un saturu
titles.en: Regulations on the procedure for submitting suspicious transaction reports and the threshold declaration and on their content

payload.shortName: Noteikumi par aizdomīgu darījumu ziņojumu un sliekšņa deklarācijas iesniegšanas kārtību un saturu
payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 17. augusta noteikumi Nr. 550 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 159, 19.08.2021.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register for the goAML system and file reports and threshold declarations through it electronically
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 17. augusta noteikumi Nr. 550 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 159, 19.08.2021.), 4., 6., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Register for the goAML system and file reports and threshold declarations through it electronically

summaries.en: An obliged entity applies for user rights on the Financial Intelligence Unit's website with documents showing who may represent it, and its main representative approves or blocks the access of its other users and hands the account over when the representative changes. It files suspicious transaction reports and threshold declarations electronically, through the online form or by uploading an XML file built to the schema the Unit publishes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Declare every week cash transactions of 7,000 euros and cross-border payments of 500,000 euros or more
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 17. augusta noteikumi Nr. 550 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 159, 19.08.2021.), 11., 12. un 13. punkts un 14.1. un 14.4. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Declare every week cash transactions of 7,000 euros and cross-border payments of 500,000 euros or more

summaries.en: A provider of payment services connected with cash or cross-border payments files a threshold declaration with the Financial Intelligence Unit once a week for each transaction since its last declaration in which a client makes a cash transaction equivalent to 7,000 euros or more, other than cash credited or withdrawn under a cash collection service, or sends or receives a cross-border payment equivalent to 500,000 euros or more. A credit institution or company that buys and sells foreign currency in cash also declares each such purchase or sale of 5,000 euros or more. Amounts in other currencies are converted at the European Central Bank's euro reference rate on the day of the transaction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Declare life insurance payouts and surrenders of 100,000 euros or more
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 17. augusta noteikumi Nr. 550 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 159, 19.08.2021.), 11. punkts un 14.2. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Declare life insurance payouts and surrenders of 100,000 euros or more

summaries.en: An insurer or insurance intermediary that provides life insurance or other insurance linked to the accumulation of funds files a threshold declaration with the Financial Intelligence Unit, once a week for the period since its last declaration, for each insurance indemnity or surrender value paid out that is equivalent to 100,000 euros or more.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give every suspicious transaction report and threshold declaration the content the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 17. augusta noteikumi Nr. 550 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 159, 19.08.2021.), 15., 16. un 17. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Give every suspicious transaction report and threshold declaration the content the regulation lists

summaries.en: A report or declaration covers at least one transaction or act and states, as far as known, the parties and persons connected with them, their accounts and the transaction with its amount, with the indicator code for the threshold case or, in a report, the suspected offence and at least one typology indicator. A suspicious transaction report also gives the grounds for filing it, what the firm has done about the matter, the IP addresses used where they can be established and any other funds, goods or services involved, and is flagged when it concerns tax and is to go on to the State Revenue Service.

instruments.title: Add Kārtība, kādā likuma subjekts veic klienta neklātienes identifikāciju, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 392 of 3 July 2018 on remote identification of customers under the anti-money-laundering law
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 3. jūlija noteikumi Nr. 392 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 133, 05.07.2018.), consolidated text, the version in force from 14.06.2022; issued under section 22(3) of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (preamble); entry into force: the passport (Stājas spēkā: 06.07.2018.), the text having no such point

titles.lv: Kārtība, kādā Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas likuma subjekts veic klienta neklātienes identifikāciju
titles.en: Procedure by which a subject of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing identifies a customer remotely

payload.shortName: Kārtība, kādā likuma subjekts veic klienta neklātienes identifikāciju
payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 3. jūlija noteikumi Nr. 392 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 133, 05.07.2018.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify customers remotely only on a risk assessment and after the preconditions are met
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 3. jūlija noteikumi Nr. 392 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 133, 05.07.2018.), 2., 3. un 4. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 14.06.2022

titles.en: Identify customers remotely only on a risk assessment and after the preconditions are met

summaries.en: Before it identifies customers remotely, an obliged entity must have carried out and documented a money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risk assessment, set up an internal control system that matches the risk, trained the staff concerned, told the customer about the process and the customer's rights and duties in it, and set security requirements for the technology. It does not identify remotely where the law requires the customer's presence or the method does not match the customer's risk, and it stops or switches method when it finds that mismatch, doubts about the security of the process or the truth of the information, or a conflict with what customer due diligence has shown.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use only the permitted technological solutions for remote identification, within their limits
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 3. jūlija noteikumi Nr. 392 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 133, 05.07.2018.), 7., 9., 11., 12. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 14.06.2022

titles.en: Use only the permitted technological solutions for remote identification, within their limits

summaries.en: An obliged entity uses, as its risk assessment indicates, one or more of four solutions: a secure electronic signature or qualified electronic identification, video identification, identity data obtained from a credit institution or payment institution through an identification payment or a similar method, or a comparison of a photograph of the identity document with an electronic self-portrait. With video identification and the photograph comparison it checks the document's security features that can be checked remotely, compares the person's biometric data, and accepts only documents with a machine-readable zone and optical security features. It may not use bank-sourced identity data or the photograph comparison where the customer or beneficial owner is connected with a high-risk third country or a low-tax or tax-free country or territory.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out video identification live, over an encrypted connection, with an audit record
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 3. jūlija noteikumi Nr. 392 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 133, 05.07.2018.), 10. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 14.06.2022

titles.en: Carry out video identification live, over an encrypted connection, with an audit record

summaries.en: Video identification is carried out in real time, interviewing the customer in synchronised video and audio streaming over an encrypted connection. The person's face, uncovered and clearly visible, is compared with the picture in the identity document shown, questions are asked to clarify or check the customer's information, and an audit record of the audio and video is kept with an unalterable time stamp, the person's name and the IP address of the connection. If the stream is interrupted the identification is done again.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Delegate remote identification only to a provider that is under EU anti-money-laundering requirements and is overseen
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 3. jūlija noteikumi Nr. 392 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 133, 05.07.2018.), 6. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 14.06.2022

titles.en: Delegate remote identification only to a provider that is under EU anti-money-laundering requirements and is overseen

summaries.en: An obliged entity identifies the customer remotely itself, within its group of companies, or through an outsourcing provider. It may delegate only where the provider is subject to the anti-money-laundering requirements that follow from EU law, where it has established before using the service that the provider is able to carry out remote identification, where it supervises that the service meets the legal requirements, and where the other rules on outsourcing are observed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage the security of the identification technology and keep unalterable records of each remote identification
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 3. jūlija noteikumi Nr. 392 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 133, 05.07.2018.), 8., 15., 16. un 17. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 14.06.2022

titles.en: Manage the security of the identification technology and keep unalterable records of each remote identification

summaries.en: An obliged entity continuously manages the security of the technology it uses, taking current vulnerabilities and fraud scenarios into account, and sets in its policies and procedures how a business relationship starts with a customer identified remotely. It documents and keeps the information obtained in the procedure, including the video and audio material, for the period the law sets, ensures that the identification and technical data cannot be altered, and is able to retrieve which customers were identified remotely, by which staff and with which solution.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze every credit to a frozen account and tell the Financial Intelligence Unit of each one at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 12. septembra noteikumi Nr. 547 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 176A, 12.09.2025.), 14. un 15. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Freeze every credit to a frozen account and tell the Financial Intelligence Unit of each one at once

summaries.en: A financial institution or credit institution that receives funds transferred by third parties to the account of a subject under these national sanctions may credit the frozen account only if every such credit is frozen as well, and informs the Financial Intelligence Unit of each such transaction without delay. Interest and other earnings on the account, payments due under contracts concluded before the sanctions were imposed and payments due under court rulings or administrative decisions made or enforceable in Latvia may likewise be credited only if they are frozen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet no claim of a sanctioned subject under a contract the national sanctions affect
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 12. septembra noteikumi Nr. 547 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 176A, 12.09.2025.), 13. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Meet no claim of a sanctioned subject under a contract the national sanctions affect

summaries.en: A claim arising from any contract whose performance is affected, directly or indirectly, in whole or in part, by the financial or entry restrictions imposed under this regulation is not satisfied when it is brought by the sanctioned subject or by any natural or legal person acting through or on behalf of that subject.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply sanctions restrictions at once and without prior warning
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2024. gada 26. marta noteikumi Nr. 184 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 63A, 28.03.2024.), 14. un 15. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 05.04.2025

titles.en: Apply sanctions restrictions at once and without prior warning

summaries.en: A person carrying out international or national sanctions that freeze funds, forbid making funds available directly or indirectly or impose any other restriction ensures that the restrictions set by the sanctions rules are observed immediately and without prior warning. A freeze of economic resources is carried out so that the sanctioned subject cannot draw a financial or economic benefit from them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the Financial Intelligence Unit the information and documents that justify each freeze or release
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2024. gada 26. marta noteikumi Nr. 184 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 63A, 28.03.2024.), 21. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 05.04.2025

titles.en: Send the Financial Intelligence Unit the information and documents that justify each freeze or release

summaries.en: When a person informs the Financial Intelligence Unit of a freeze under section 12(5) of the sanctions law, it submits the information and documents showing that the freezing, or the release from freezing, was carried out in line with the law. Where funds or economic resources of the same subject were already frozen and reported, it reports only the newly frozen ones and does not repeat the justification.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Weigh the sanctions of an EU or NATO member state that materially affect the financial market, and manage that risk
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2024. gada 26. marta noteikumi Nr. 184 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 63A, 28.03.2024.), 45., 46. un 47. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 05.04.2025

titles.en: Weigh the sanctions of an EU or NATO member state that materially affect the financial market, and manage that risk

summaries.en: In its sanctions risk assessment a financial market participant evaluates sanctions imposed by an EU or NATO member state whose official currency, other than the euro, is the main one for settlements in international trade and financial markets, considering at least the currencies it offers services in, its contracts with other financial institutions and correspondent banks, the regions where it and its subsidiaries, branches and representative offices operate, and the countries where its clients operate. Where it finds a material effect on itself or on the interests of the financial market, it manages sanctions risk for that state's sanctions as well.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the risks of a member state's financial restrictions and set matching limits on services and transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2024. gada 26. marta noteikumi Nr. 184 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 63A, 28.03.2024.), 48. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 05.04.2025

titles.en: Assess the risks of a member state's financial restrictions and set matching limits on services and transactions

summaries.en: When it applies financial restrictions set in the sanctions of an EU or NATO member state, a financial market participant assesses the risks connected with them, legal risks included, and sets restrictions that match the assessment. It may decide to provide no services or limited services to a person under such restrictions, or to carry out no transactions or only certain transactions in which such a person is a party.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep consumer credit advertising responsible and show the standard cost information by an example
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 13. un 14. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Keep consumer credit advertising responsible and show the standard cost information by an example

summaries.en: An advertisement that offers credit to consumers may not encourage irresponsible borrowing, for instance by inviting borrowing without thought or regardless of the consumer's finances, by suggesting that credit is free of risk or the best answer to money problems or by offering unrelated goods and benefits, and may not say that credit is open to people with a negative credit history. Where it gives an interest rate or any other figure on the cost of the credit, it sets out by a representative example, clearly and concisely, the borrowing rate with the charges included in the total cost, the total amount of credit, the annual percentage rate at least as prominently as any other rate, the duration, the total amount payable with the instalments, and any ancillary service the consumer must take.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer the European standard consumer credit information before the contract binds
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 20., 21. un 22. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Give the consumer the European standard consumer credit information before the contract binds

summaries.en: Before the consumer is bound by a credit agreement or accepts an offer, the lender or credit intermediary gives the consumer, in good time and free of charge, the information needed to compare offers and take an informed decision, on the terms the lender offers and the wishes the consumer has stated. It is given on the Standard European Consumer Credit Information form in annex 3, on paper or another durable medium, with every item equally prominent, and covers among other things the type and total amount of credit, the duration, the borrowing rate, the annual percentage rate and total amount payable shown by an example, the payments, the costs, default interest, security required, the right of withdrawal and the right to repay early.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give general information on mortgage credit at all times and the personalised European standardised information sheet before the contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 31., 32., 33., 35. un 36. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Give general information on mortgage credit at all times and the personalised European standardised information sheet before the contract

summaries.en: For credit secured on immovable property or meant to acquire or keep rights in it, the lender or credit intermediary keeps clear general information on its credit agreements available to consumers at any time and free of charge, with at least the items the regulation lists. Before the consumer is bound it gives, without undue delay and free of charge, personalised information on the European Standardised Information Sheet in annex 2, on paper or another durable medium, based on the consumer's stated wishes, financial situation and needs. A binding offer is given on paper or another durable medium with that sheet attached unless it was already given and still matches, and the lender offers a copy of the draft agreement free of charge.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Say whether advice is given, base it on the consumer's situation and hand over a record of the recommendation
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 48., 49., 50., 52. un 53. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Say whether advice is given, base it on the consumer's situation and hand over a record of the recommendation

summaries.en: Before advising, or before a contract for advice, a lender or credit intermediary tells the consumer clearly whether advice is or can be given and states, on paper or another durable medium and free of charge, whether the advice rests only on its own range of credit products or on a wide range from the market, and the fee or how it is calculated. It obtains the information needed on the consumer's personal and financial situation, wishes and aims, considers a sufficiently large number of credit agreements, recommends those that suit the consumer, acts in the consumer's interests and gives the consumer a record of the recommendation on paper or another durable medium. It warns the consumer where, given the consumer's finances, a credit agreement may carry a particular risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give holders of foreign currency mortgage loans a right to convert and warn them when the rate moves by more than 20 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 85., 86., 87., 88. un 89. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Give holders of foreign currency mortgage loans a right to convert and warn them when the rate moves by more than 20 per cent

summaries.en: Where a loan under an agreement covered by chapter X is a foreign currency loan when the agreement is concluded, and the outstanding total amount payable or the regular instalments come to differ by more than 20 per cent from what they would be at the exchange rate of that day, the lender ensures the consumer's right to convert the loan into an alternative currency as the agreement provides, at the market rate on the day of conversion unless the agreement says otherwise, or another arrangement in the agreement that limits the exchange rate risk. During the agreement the lender warns the consumer on paper or another durable medium regularly, at least once a year and at least when that 20 per cent difference arises. The arrangements are set out free of charge in the European Standardised Information Sheet and in the agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the consumer of a change in the borrowing rate one month before it takes effect
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 91. un 92. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Tell the consumer of a change in the borrowing rate one month before it takes effect

summaries.en: Where the credit agreement lets the lender change the borrowing rate, the lender informs the consumer individually of any change one month before it takes effect, unless another law provides otherwise or the agreement sets a longer period, in writing or on another agreed durable medium and with the amount of the payments after the change and any change in their number and frequency. Where the change follows from a reference rate and the new rate is publicly available, the parties may agree that the information is given periodically, though for credit secured on or meant for immovable property the consumer is still told individually.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Charge compensation for early repayment only during a fixed-rate period and within the caps
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 99., 101., 102., 103. un 104. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Charge compensation for early repayment only during a fixed-rate period and within the caps

summaries.en: A lender may claim no compensation for early repayment, costs included, except where the credit is repaid early during a period for which the agreement fixes the borrowing rate, when it may take fair and objectively justified compensation for costs directly linked to the early repayment. That compensation may not exceed 1 per cent of the amount repaid early where more than a year of the agreement remains or 0.5 per cent where a year or less remains, nor the interest the consumer would have paid until the end of the agreement, and none is due where the amount repaid early in 12 months is not above 9,960 euros, where repayment comes from insurance meant to guarantee repayment, or under an overdraft facility. The consumer owes interest and other charges only up to the day the credit is fully settled.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Follow the steps and deadlines of the mortgage refinancing process as acquiring or previous lender
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 25. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 691 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 213, 01.11.2016.), 116.¹, 116.², 116.³, 116.⁴, 116.⁵, 116.⁶ un 116.¹² punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 18.04.2025

titles.en: Follow the steps and deadlines of the mortgage refinancing process as acquiring or previous lender

summaries.en: A lender that receives a consumer's application to refinance a mortgage loan held with another lender tells the previous lender that the process has begun, confirms the consumer's wish and asks for the monthly payment, the maximum outstanding balance as it would stand on the sixtieth day, the data on the mortgaged property and any Altum guarantee or subsidy. The previous lender supplies this within 10 working days, or refuses on the ground that the consumer has accepted its own offer to change the existing terms, and gives its consent to the change of the mortgage and the related prohibition note within three working days of being told by the acquiring lender, once the new agreement is concluded and its conditions are met, that the change is being started. The lenders exchange data in a secure way, and information and notices are signed with a secure electronic signature and carry a qualified electronic seal.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer the listed information on the provider, the service and the contract on a durable medium before a distance contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2026. gada 22. septembra noteikumi Nr. 561 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 184, 24.09.2026.), 5., 6., 7., 8., 9., 10. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Give the consumer the listed information on the provider, the service and the contract on a durable medium before a distance contract

summaries.en: Before a distance contract for a financial service is concluded, the provider gives the consumer, legibly and on a durable medium, its identity, address, contacts and supervisor, a description of the service, the total price with all charges and taxes or how it is calculated, any personalised pricing by automated decision, the special risks of financial instruments, the payment arrangements, the right of withdrawal and the amount payable on withdrawal, the minimum term, termination rights, the applicable law and court, the languages and the out-of-court redress available. Where another act regulates the same information, that act applies instead, and in a dispute the provider must prove it met these duties.

obligations.title: Add the duty: State the firm's name and commercial purpose at the start of a sales call and send a withdrawal reminder when information came late
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2026. gada 22. septembra noteikumi Nr. 561 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 184, 24.09.2026.), 13., 14. un 15. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: State the firm's name and commercial purpose at the start of a sales call and send a withdrawal reminder when information came late

summaries.en: Where a distance contract or offer is made by voice telephony, the provider's representative states the provider's name and the commercial purpose of the call at the start and says if the call is or may be recorded, and with the consumer's explicit consent may give only the core information before the contract binds, sending the rest on a durable medium immediately after conclusion. Where the pre-contract information is given less than one day before the consumer is bound, the provider sends, between one and seven days after conclusion and on a durable medium, a reminder of the right of withdrawal and how to use it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Honour the consumer's right to withdraw within 14 days and refund within 30 days, charging only for service already provided
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2026. gada 22. septembra noteikumi Nr. 561 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 184, 24.09.2026.), 17., 18., 22., 30., 32. un 33. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Honour the consumer's right to withdraw within 14 days and refund within 30 days, charging only for service already provided

summaries.en: A consumer may withdraw from a distance contract within 14 days, or 30 days for private pension operations, counted from conclusion or from receiving the terms and information if later, and a linked contract for other services ends without penalty. The provider refunds what it received within 30 days of the notice and may charge only an amount proportionate to the service already provided that is not a penalty, and nothing where it cannot prove the consumer was told of that amount or where it started performing before the end of the withdrawal period without the consumer's request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide a permanently available online withdrawal button and confirm receipt of the withdrawal on a durable medium
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2026. gada 22. septembra noteikumi Nr. 561 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 184, 24.09.2026.), 23., 24., 25., 26., 27. un 28. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Provide a permanently available online withdrawal button and confirm receipt of the withdrawal on a durable medium

summaries.en: Where a distance contract was concluded through an online interface, the provider lets the consumer withdraw through a withdrawal function labelled with the words the regulation sets or another unambiguous wording, prominently displayed and available throughout the withdrawal period, that lets the consumer give or confirm name, the contract and the electronic means for the acknowledgement, followed by a confirmation function. After the consumer confirms, the provider sends without undue delay, on a durable medium, an acknowledgement of receipt with the content, date and time of the withdrawal.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain offered financial services free of charge before the contract and give access to a person when online tools are used
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2026. gada 22. septembra noteikumi Nr. 561 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 184, 24.09.2026.), 35. un 36. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Explain offered financial services free of charge before the contract and give access to a person when online tools are used

summaries.en: Before the contract, and free of charge, the provider gives the consumer adequate explanations that let the consumer judge whether the offered contract and any ancillary services suit the consumer's needs and financial situation, covering the pre-contract information, the main features and the consequences, including those of missed or late payments. Where it uses online tools, the consumer may ask for, and the provider must ensure, human intervention before the contract and in justified cases after it, in the language of the pre-contract information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Design online interfaces that do not mislead or manipulate consumers and make cancelling no harder than signing up
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2026. gada 22. septembra noteikumi Nr. 561 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 184, 24.09.2026.), 38. un 39. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Design online interfaces that do not mislead or manipulate consumers and make cancelling no harder than signing up

summaries.en: A provider does not design, organise or operate its online interfaces in a way that deceives or manipulates consumers or otherwise materially distorts or impairs their ability to make free and informed decisions. It gives no visual prominence to one choice when consumers are asked to choose, does not ask again for a choice already made, and makes terminating a service no more difficult than subscribing to it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send account register data in the published XML structure with a unique identifier for each item
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 28. marta noteikumi Nr. 186 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 73, 10.04.2017.), 3., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Send account register data in the published XML structure with a unique identifier for each item

summaries.en: A data supplier sends its data to the account register in one or more messages that follow the XML schema structure the State Revenue Service publishes. For each item about a natural or legal person's account or safe deposit box in use, and the information connected with it, it gives a unique identifier.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Correct or withdraw an earlier account register item under its identifier with the mark the regulation sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 28. marta noteikumi Nr. 186 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 73, 10.04.2017.), 9., 10. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Correct or withdraw an earlier account register item under its identifier with the mark the regulation sets

summaries.en: Where a data supplier finds that an item it sent holds information on the account holder or safe deposit box user that must be deleted from the register, it sends the item again with the earlier item's unique identifier and the mark for deletion. Where the information on the holder or user is wrong, it sends a corrected item with the earlier identifier and the mark for correction. Where the account or box number is wrong, it withdraws the earlier item with the deletion mark and sends a corrected item under a new identifier.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Connect to the state data distribution network, clear sent data within five working days and resume within two after an outage
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 28. marta noteikumi Nr. 186 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 73, 10.04.2017.), 12., 13., 14., 15. un 17. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Connect to the state data distribution network, clear sent data within five working days and resume within two after an outage

summaries.en: A data supplier connects to the data distribution network of the state information systems integrator on its own, obtains user rights from the agency that runs it and then requests connection to the State Revenue Service's channel. It deletes the data it has placed in or received from the network within five working days, and when the network's operation is interrupted it resumes supplying data within two working days after the network is restored.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As a user of the account register, control who queries it, state the purpose and keep the data no longer than five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 28. marta noteikumi Nr. 186 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 73, 10.04.2017.), 20., 38., 48., 50., 52. un 59. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: As a user of the account register, control who queries it, state the purpose and keep the data no longer than five years

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment service provider that obtains data from the account register sets up an internal control system that secures compliance with data protection rules and the use of the data for the purpose the Account Register Law allows, states the purpose in every request, and ensures that only the persons it has authorised in its own system request and receive data. It protects its access credentials, tells the State Revenue Service at once of a security incident in its system that threatens the register, and keeps data received from the register in electronic form no longer than five years after the account is closed or the safe deposit box lease ends, save where anti-money-laundering law provides otherwise.

instruments.title: Add Kārtība, kādā finanšu iestāde izpilda finanšu kontu pienācīgas pārbaudes procedūras, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 20 of 5 January 2016 on due diligence of financial accounts and their reporting to the State Revenue Service (CRS)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a tax residence self-certification when opening an individual's account and check it against the onboarding file
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 5. janvāra noteikumi Nr. 20 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 9, 14.01.2016.), 40., 41., 42. un 43. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Obtain a tax residence self-certification when opening an individual's account and check it against the onboarding file

summaries.en: When it opens a new account for a natural person, a financial institution obtains a self-certification that lets it determine the holder's residence for tax purposes, with the tax identification number and date of birth, and confirms that it is reasonable against the information obtained at opening, the documents gathered under its anti-money-laundering customer due diligence included. A self-certification showing residence in a participating jurisdiction makes the account reportable. When a change in circumstances shows that the self-certification is wrong or unreliable, the institution may not rely on it and obtains a new one.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Determine whether a new entity account is held by a reportable person or a passive entity with reportable controlling persons
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 5. janvāra noteikumi Nr. 20 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 9, 14.01.2016.), 50., 51. un 52.¹ punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Determine whether a new entity account is held by a reportable person or a passive entity with reportable controlling persons

summaries.en: For a new entity account a financial institution obtains a self-certification of the holder's tax residence and confirms its reasonableness, treating the account as reportable where the holder is resident in a participating jurisdiction unless information it holds or that is publicly available shows that the holder is not a reportable person. It then determines whether the holder is a passive non-financial entity, identifies its controlling persons, for which it may rely on its anti-money-laundering procedures, and determines whether any of them is a reportable person, relying on a self-certification of their tax residence. When a change in circumstances shows that the documentation is wrong or unreliable, it determines the account's status again.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Review pre-existing high-value individual accounts with an electronic search, a paper search where needed and the relationship manager's knowledge
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 5. janvāra noteikumi Nr. 20 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 9, 14.01.2016.), 29., 30., 32., 37.¹ un 39. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Review pre-existing high-value individual accounts with an electronic search, a paper search where needed and the relationship manager's knowledge

summaries.en: For a pre-existing individual account of high value a financial institution searches its electronically searchable data for the indicia of tax residence and, where its systems do not hold all the information the regulation lists, also searches the paper records. It also weighs what the relationship manager in regular contact with the holder knows, and has procedures under which the relationship manager confirms once a year that the holders' status matches the institution's information and identifies and documents any change in circumstances concerning the account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a new self-certification within 90 days of a change in circumstances or treat the holder as resident in both jurisdictions
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 5. janvāra noteikumi Nr. 20 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 9, 14.01.2016.), 17., 17.¹, 18. un 19. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Obtain a new self-certification within 90 days of a change in circumstances or treat the holder as resident in both jurisdictions

summaries.en: A financial institution may not rely on a self-certification or documentary evidence it knows or has reason to know is incorrect or unreliable. Where a change in circumstances shows that the documentation for a new individual account or any entity account is wrong, it may keep treating the holder as before only until 90 days have passed, a new self-certification is received or the earlier one is confirmed, whichever comes first. If it cannot obtain a new self-certification or a confirmation within 90 days, it treats the holder as resident both where the earlier self-certification says and where the change in circumstances indicates.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the records of the due diligence steps and the evidence used for five years after reporting the account
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 5. janvāra noteikumi Nr. 20 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 9, 14.01.2016.), 19.¹ punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Keep the records of the due diligence steps and the evidence used for five years after reporting the account

summaries.en: A financial institution keeps the information on the measures it took and the evidence it used in carrying out the due diligence procedures for at least five years from the time it reported to the State Revenue Service on the reportable account the information concerns.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the financial account report through the State Revenue Service's web service in the OECD XML schema by 31 July
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 5. janvāra noteikumi Nr. 20 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 9, 14.01.2016.), 60., 62., 64., 66., 68., 69. un 73. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: File the financial account report through the State Revenue Service's web service in the OECD XML schema by 31 July

summaries.en: A financial institution files the information on reportable accounts electronically through the State Revenue Service's web service, in XML files that follow the OECD schema, by 31 July of the year after the reporting period. It reports a holder or controlling person resident in several participating jurisdictions separately for each, and a closed account by reporting the closure without a closing balance. If it has nothing to report it files a confirmation through the electronic declaration system by the same day, and if it cannot report as required it tells the State Revenue Service by 31 July why and when it will.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Correct a rejected financial account report within 10 working days and a partner jurisdiction's query within two months
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2016. gada 5. janvāra noteikumi Nr. 20 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 9, 14.01.2016.), 71., 76. un 77. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Correct a rejected financial account report within 10 working days and a partner jurisdiction's query within two months

summaries.en: A financial institution files the corrections the State Revenue Service asks for after finding that a report does not meet the XML schema within 10 working days of being told. Where a participating jurisdiction's competent authority reports the information as wrong or incomplete, the institution files the requested or corrected information within two months of hearing from the State Revenue Service, or within the same two months tells it why it cannot and when it will.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the FATCA report, or a nil report, through the State Revenue Service's web service by 31 July
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2015. gada 24. marta noteikumi Nr. 134 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 61, 26.03.2015.), 5., 5.¹, 6., 7. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 08.11.2016

titles.en: File the FATCA report, or a nil report, through the State Revenue Service's web service by 31 July

summaries.en: A Latvian financial institution files electronically, through the State Revenue Service's web service, the information the agreement requires on United States reportable accounts and on payments to nonparticipating financial institutions by 31 July of the year after the reporting year, in one XML file that follows the FATCA XML schema and observing the agreement's exceptions. If it holds no such information it files a nil report by the same day, and if it cannot report as required it tells the State Revenue Service by 31 July why and when it will.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Correct a FATCA report within 10 working days of the State Revenue Service's notice and within 40 after a query from the IRS
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2015. gada 24. marta noteikumi Nr. 134 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 61, 26.03.2015.), 9., 14. un 15. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 08.11.2016

titles.en: Correct a FATCA report within 10 working days of the State Revenue Service's notice and within 40 after a query from the IRS

summaries.en: A Latvian financial institution files the corrections the State Revenue Service asks for after checking its report within 10 working days of the notice. Where the United States Internal Revenue Service reports the information as wrong, incomplete or otherwise not in line with the agreement, the institution files the requested or corrected information within 40 working days of hearing from the State Revenue Service, or within the same period tells it why it cannot and when it will.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As an intermediary, report a reportable cross-border arrangement to the State Revenue Service within 30 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2020. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 210 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 75, 17.04.2020.), 6., 7. un 20. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: As an intermediary, report a reportable cross-border arrangement to the State Revenue Service within 30 days

summaries.en: An intermediary reports to the State Revenue Service the information it knows, holds or controls on a reportable cross-border arrangement within 30 days of the day after the arrangement is made available for implementation or is ready for implementation, or of the moment its first step is implemented, whichever comes first. An intermediary that only gives aid, assistance or advice reports within 30 days of the day after it did so. A report counts as filed only once it is validated.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the new information on a marketable arrangement every three months
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2020. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 210 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 75, 17.04.2020.), 8. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Report the new information on a marketable arrangement every three months

summaries.en: For a marketable arrangement, one designed, marketed, ready or made available for implementation without needing substantial customisation, the intermediary files a periodic report every three months with the new reportable information identifying the intermediaries and relevant taxpayers, the dates of implementation, the Member States likely to be concerned and the persons likely to be affected that has become available since its last report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As the relevant taxpayer, report the arrangement within 30 days where no intermediary reports it
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2020. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 210 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 75, 17.04.2020.), 12., 13. un 17. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: As the relevant taxpayer, report the arrangement within 30 days where no intermediary reports it

summaries.en: Where no intermediary must report, or a lawyer acting as intermediary relies on professional secrecy and tells the taxpayer so, the duty passes to the relevant taxpayer. It reports within 30 days of the day after the arrangement is made available or ready for it to implement, or of the moment the first step is implemented for it, whichever comes first, and where there are several relevant taxpayers the one that agreed the arrangement with the intermediary reports first, otherwise the one managing its implementation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Where another reporter or Member State already has the report, send the reference number and the reason within 30 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2020. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 210 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 75, 17.04.2020.), 10., 15., 16., 18. un 19. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2026

titles.en: Where another reporter or Member State already has the report, send the reference number and the reason within 30 days

summaries.en: An intermediary or relevant taxpayer that does not report in Latvia because the same information was filed in another Member State, or because another intermediary or taxpayer has already reported it, must hold proof of that and, within 30 days of that other report, send the State Revenue Service, through its electronic declaration system, the arrangement's reference number and the reasons why it holds no other information on the arrangement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document the institution's strategy, risk appetite and capital and liquidity targets, and draw up a plan every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 8. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Document the institution's strategy, risk appetite and capital and liquidity targets, and draw up a plan every year

summaries.en: A credit institution draws up and documents a strategy that sets its business aims, target markets and clients, a risk strategy with its risk profile, risk appetite and risk capacity and what it does when its risk profile exceeds the appetite, a capital adequacy strategy with capital and leverage targets, ways to raise capital and a contingency plan, and its liquidity management aims. It also draws up a plan for each year with at least the planned financial position, market position, aims, activities, likely risks and the criteria for judging results.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a documented policy that identifies, classifies and manages conflicts of interest of staff and officers
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 38., 39., 40. un 43. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Run a documented policy that identifies, classifies and manages conflicts of interest of staff and officers

summaries.en: A credit institution draws up and documents a conflicts of interest policy and procedures for all its staff and officers that identify actual and potential conflicts in good time and prevent them, by dividing duties, by having the person concerned abstain from decisions and by keeping conflicting units independent of each other. It sets qualitative and, where possible, quantitative criteria for a material conflict, procedures for transactions with persons connected with its management, and documents every conflict identified with the measures taken.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess every new financial service, new market or material change with the risk and compliance functions before launch
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 80. un 81. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Assess every new financial service, new market or material change with the risk and compliance functions before launch

summaries.en: A credit institution draws up, documents and applies a policy for introducing new financial services, offering existing ones in new markets and making material changes to how they are provided. Before launch the chief risk officer and the risk control function assess the fit with the risk strategy and the effect on the risk profile and on the adequacy of policies, limits, staff and resources, the compliance function assesses whether the requirements will be met, and the money laundering, terrorism and proliferation financing and sanctions risks are assessed, with enough resources and named responsible units.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set up the risk, nomination and remuneration committees where required and keep independent members on the supervisory board
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 83., 84., 87. un 88. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Set up the risk, nomination and remuneration committees where required and keep independent members on the supervisory board

summaries.en: A credit institution recognised as globally or otherwise systemically important sets up a risk committee, a nomination committee and a remuneration committee to advise its supervisory board; another institution may leave the functions to the full board. A significant supervised institution keeps at least two independent members on its supervisory board, who chair those committees, and any other institution at least one, who sits on the committees it has; the rule for the latter applies from 1 July 2025.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify critical processes and resources and keep procedures to restore them in an emergency
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 105. un 106. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Identify critical processes and resources and keep procedures to restore them in an emergency

summaries.en: To keep operating and limit losses in an emergency a credit institution identifies the processes and resources critical to its business that must be restored at once, those that outsourcing providers or other third parties provide included, assesses the effect of their interruption and the maximum time allowed to restore them, and sets procedures, responsible staff, technical and organisational measures, alternative locations and resources and continuity measures for its information systems.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run independent risk control, compliance and internal audit functions
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 117., 118., 119. un 120. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Run independent risk control, compliance and internal audit functions

summaries.en: A credit institution has at least three internal control functions, risk control, compliance and internal audit, each independent of the activities it controls: its staff carry no duties in those activities, it is organisationally separate from them and its head reports to the supervisory board, and its staff's pay does not depend on their results. Internal audit is also organisationally separate from the other two functions. A management board member or key function holder may be responsible for risk control or compliance, or both, only where that suits the institution's size and complexity and the conditions the regulation sets are met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell Latvijas Banka within five working days why the head of internal audit or compliance left
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 122. un 123. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell Latvijas Banka within five working days why the head of internal audit or compliance left

summaries.en: A credit institution documents how the head of internal audit and the person responsible for compliance are appointed and dismissed, and within five working days of ending the employment of either or removing either from office it sends Latvijas Banka the reasons.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report on diversity policy and practice to Latvijas Banka every three years by 30 April
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 371 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 140., 141., 142. un 143. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report on diversity policy and practice to Latvijas Banka every three years by 30 April

summaries.en: Every three years a credit institution prepares a report on its diversity policy and practice as at the end of the third calendar year, on the EBA templates Latvijas Banka publishes, and files it individually and electronically through Latvijas Banka's high-security system by 30 April of the following year, with the contact details of the person who prepared it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set a credit risk strategy and appetite within the overall risk strategy and measure the capacity to absorb credit risk
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 265 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 07.08.2026

titles.en: Set a credit risk strategy and appetite within the overall risk strategy and measure the capacity to absorb credit risk

summaries.en: A credit institution's credit risk strategy forms part of its overall risk strategy, is aligned with its capital and liquidity adequacy assessments and sets its credit risk appetite, minimum lending standards, the desired structure and diversification of the portfolio and related limits. It sets the highest credit risk level it can absorb with its resources and documents and applies a method to assess that capacity, using past and planned own funds requirements, internal capital for credit risk, credit-related income and costs, lending volumes and stress test results.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refuse consumer credit where debt service exceeds 40 per cent of income or debt exceeds six times annual income
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 265 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 63., 69., 71. un 72. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 07.08.2026

titles.en: Refuse consumer credit where debt service exceeds 40 per cent of income or debt exceeds six times annual income

summaries.en: In assessing a consumer's creditworthiness a credit institution uses, besides qualitative indicators, at least the debt service to income ratio, the debt to annual income ratio and the loan to value ratio, calculated by the formulas the regulation sets. Where the debt service ratio exceeds 40 per cent or the debt ratio exceeds 6, the creditworthiness is insufficient and the loan may not be granted, unless the borrower's assessment shows the borrower can repay at the higher level. For a home with an energy efficiency class of A+, A, B or C the limits are 45 per cent and 8, and the limits do not apply to forborne exposures or to the cases the Consumer Rights Protection Law exempts from the creditworthiness assessment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep exceptions from the borrower-based limits within 10 per cent of new lending to individuals each quarter and document each one
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 265 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 70. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 07.08.2026

titles.en: Keep exceptions from the borrower-based limits within 10 per cent of new lending to individuals each quarter and document each one

summaries.en: Exceptions from the debt service and debt ratio limits, the maximum maturities and the limits for individuals borrowing for real estate activities together may not exceed 10 per cent of the amount of new loans to natural persons in a calendar quarter, based on the latest data for the previous quarter. An exception is allowed only where the assessment shows the borrower can repay despite exceeding the limits, and the institution documents the kind of exception and can explain the risk-mitigating elements in each case.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Lend to individuals for no longer than 30 years for a home and seven years for consumer credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 265 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 43. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 07.08.2026

titles.en: Lend to individuals for no longer than 30 years for a home and seven years for consumer credit

summaries.en: A loan to a natural person to buy a home may have a repayment term of at most 30 years from the day the agreement takes effect, and consumer credit, financial leasing included, at most seven years. Where the institution reassesses the borrower's creditworthiness under an existing agreement or grants a new loan in a mortgage refinancing, the term may run from the day the amended or new agreement takes effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Weigh the stability of a consumer's income, regular expenses and guarantees given when assessing creditworthiness
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 265 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 75., 76., 77., 80. un 81. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 07.08.2026

titles.en: Weigh the stability of a consumer's income, regular expenses and guarantees given when assessing creditworthiness

summaries.en: A credit institution analyses the stability of a consumer borrower's income, sets stricter requirements, stricter ratio limits among them, for a borrower whose income fluctuates or is in a currency other than the loan's, and takes into account regular expenses unrelated to debt, such as rent, utilities and dependants, under its own method. It counts guarantees the borrower has given at no less than 50 per cent of the outstanding guaranteed amount in the ratios, assesses a guarantor's own capacity separately under the same limits, and sets each guarantor's share in the guarantee agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold a current collateral valuation when granting a loan and check the collateral's legal enforceability
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 265 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 95., 96. un 97. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 07.08.2026

titles.en: Hold a current collateral valuation when granting a loan and check the collateral's legal enforceability

summaries.en: When a loan is granted a credit institution has a current valuation of the collateral and analyses its existence, suitability and sufficiency against the loan to value ratio set in its lending policy and the possibilities of realising it under different scenarios. It sets which kinds of collateral suit which loans and which prudent valuation approaches the valuer uses, and before accepting collateral checks its legal conditions, the possibility of taking it over and selling it and of insuring it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a complete credit file and monitor loan quality continuously with early warning indicators
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 265 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 115., 116., 117., 129., 130. un 131. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 07.08.2026

titles.en: Keep a complete credit file and monitor loan quality continuously with early warning indicators

summaries.en: A credit institution continuously checks and documents in the credit file the borrower's ability to meet the agreement, keeping all the information needed to assess the current financial position and to retrace decisions and credit history. It runs a system that monitors the quality of individual loans and portfolios continuously, follows covenants, collateral adequacy and the use of funds, applies a set of early warning indicators of deteriorating quality at borrower, group and portfolio level and acts on their signals.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the boards own a prudent liquidity risk strategy, policies and procedures, intraday risk included
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 333 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 5., 6. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Have the boards own a prudent liquidity risk strategy, policies and procedures, intraday risk included

summaries.en: A credit institution's supervisory and management boards are responsible for effective liquidity risk management and the liquidity adequacy assessment process. The institution draws up a prudent liquidity risk strategy, policies and procedures that identify, measure, analyse and monitor liquidity risk in good time over the relevant periods, intraday included, to keep an adequate liquidity buffer, matching its size, liquidity risk profile, the variety and complexity of its operations and its risk tolerance.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Diversify funding sources and maturities and the assets usable as collateral
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 333 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 26., 27., 28. un 29. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Diversify funding sources and maturities and the assets usable as collateral

summaries.en: A credit institution manages funding liquidity risk and controls its funding structure, diversifies its funding sources and maturities effectively and, where appropriate, sets concentration limits by counterparty or connected group, by secured and unsecured market funding, by maturity and by region. It assesses and controls the assets it can pledge for borrowing in each currency and country where it operates materially and diversifies them, allowing for legal, regulatory and operational limits, price volatility, haircuts and extra collateral calls in a crisis.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stress test liquidity at least every six months with institution-specific, market-wide and combined scenarios
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 333 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 30., 31. un 32. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Stress test liquidity at least every six months with institution-specific, market-wide and combined scenarios

summaries.en: To find potential sources of liquidity problems and size its liquidity buffer, a credit institution stress tests at least every six months with an institution-specific crisis, a market-wide crisis and a combined scenario, using tests of varying severity with a material but plausible impact, and in setting the assumptions also assesses possible changes in its other commitments, including the effect of a securitisation vehicle it sponsors or supports with liquidity.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a liquidity contingency plan with assets ready for central bank funding and test it at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 333 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 39., 40., 41. un 42. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a liquidity contingency plan with assets ready for central bank funding and test it at least once a year

summaries.en: A credit institution keeps a plan for overcoming a possible liquidity crisis with the procedures and coordination its management will use to limit the effect of adverse events in time and at reasonable cost: the responsible persons and their deputies, their powers and reporting lines, the triggering events, a detailed action plan with timings, the funding sources and amounts available and how it will communicate with staff, customers, shareholders, Latvijas Banka and the media. It holds assets immediately available for central bank funding as the plan requires and tests the plan's effectiveness at least once a year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the liquidity adequacy assessment report with Latvijas Banka by 31 May or 30 June
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 333 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 43., 46., 48. un 49. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File the liquidity adequacy assessment report with Latvijas Banka by 31 May or 30 June

summaries.en: A credit institution prepares a report on its liquidity adequacy assessment process with a summary of results and conclusions, a description of the process, internal audit's findings, the follow-up of Latvijas Banka's last instructions, its internal documents and a description of its data and IT systems, and files it electronically with copies and a list of its internal rules on liquidity risk, stress testing and the process. It files by 31 May of the following year if it is identified as an other systemically important institution and by 30 June otherwise.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a remuneration policy suited to the bank and have it reviewed independently every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 14. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 322 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 202, 16.10.2024.), 7., 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a remuneration policy suited to the bank and have it reviewed independently every year

summaries.en: A credit institution develops, applies and maintains a remuneration policy, a pension policy included, suited to its size, business, complexity and organisation, and has its policy and principles assessed independently at least once a year, at group level where needed, together with their fit for its risk, capital and liquidity management and for changes in external factors and law. People in control and human resources functions take part in developing, applying, monitoring and reviewing the policy and the process for identifying risk takers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base variable pay on multi-year performance measured with financial and non-financial criteria and adjusted for risk
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 14. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 322 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 202, 16.10.2024.), 17., 18., 19., 21., 24. un 26. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Base variable pay on multi-year performance measured with financial and non-financial criteria and adjusted for risk

summaries.en: A credit institution documents how it assesses performance and sets, awards and vests variable pay and tells the people assessed. It uses non-financial criteria such as compliance with rules and limits, fair treatment of customers and customer satisfaction besides financial ones, bases the assessment on long-term results over several years in line with its business cycle and risks, adjusts accounting-based measures for future risks, combines individual, unit and institution results, and takes current and potential risks into account when setting, awarding and vesting variable pay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify the staff who affect the bank's risk profile at least once a year and document the decisions
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 14. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 322 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 202, 16.10.2024.), 27. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Identify the staff who affect the bank's risk profile at least once a year and document the decisions

summaries.en: A credit institution carries out the assessment and identification of the positions that have a material impact on its risk profile at least once a year, and documents the decisions so that they give a clear picture of the result and contain at least the information the regulation lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Defer 40 to 60 per cent of risk takers' variable pay for four to five years, pay half in instruments and apply malus and clawback
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 14. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 322 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 202, 16.10.2024.), 28. un 29. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Defer 40 to 60 per cent of risk takers' variable pay for four to five years, pay half in instruments and apply malus and clawback

summaries.en: For risk takers a credit institution defers at least 40 per cent of variable pay, or 60 per cent where variable pay is 100 per cent of fixed pay or more, for no less than four to five years, sets at least 50 per cent in shares, share-linked or capital instruments held for at least a year, vests the deferred part pro rata no earlier than 12 months after award and pays it out no more than once a year. Variable pay is paid only where it does not weaken the institution's sound financial position, is reduced when results deteriorate or turn negative, and is subject to malus and clawback. Deferral, instruments and retention do not apply to an institution that is not large with average assets of no more than 5 billion euros over four years, nor to a person whose variable pay is no more than 50,000 euros and a third of total annual pay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the EBA remuneration benchmarking and high earners reports with Latvijas Banka by 1 June
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 14. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 322 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 202, 16.10.2024.), 30. un 33. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File the EBA remuneration benchmarking and high earners reports with Latvijas Banka by 1 June

summaries.en: A credit institution files with Latvijas Banka, on the EBA templates published on Latvijas Banka's website and electronically through its high-security system, the remuneration benchmarking report and the report on high earners for each calendar year by 1 June of the following year, at group level where it is under consolidated supervision. Every three years it also files the gender pay gap report by 1 June, unless it is a small and non-complex institution or has no more than 50 employees.
