obligations.title: Add the duty: Before outsourcing, assess criticality, risks, conflicts and the provider's licence
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 374 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 11., 12., 13. un 14. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Before outsourcing, assess criticality, risks, conflicts and the provider's licence

summaries.en: Before outsourcing, an institution assesses whether the function is critical or important, identifies and assesses all material risks, checks the provider's suitability and identifies and manages possible conflicts of interest; outsourcing that supports a critical or important function is a significant outsourcing. It delegates a financial service that needs Latvijas Banka's licence to a provider in an EU or EEA state only if a supervisor there has authorised the provider, and to a provider elsewhere only if the provider is authorised and supervised there and Latvijas Banka has a cooperation agreement with that supervisor.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check the suitability of an outsourcing provider before contracting
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 374 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 51., 52. un 53. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Check the suitability of an outsourcing provider before contracting

summaries.en: Before concluding an outsourcing contract an institution satisfies itself of the provider's suitability, taking the operational risk into account. For a significant outsourcing it checks the provider's ability to perform the function, reputation, expertise, human, IT and financial resources, organisation and any licence or registration needed, considering at least the nature, scale, complexity, finances, ownership and group of the provider, whether it belongs to the institution's group and whether it is supervised.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a register of all outsourcing arrangements and hold its records for five years after each contract ends
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 374 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 40., 41., 42. un 43. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a register of all outsourcing arrangements and hold its records for five years after each contract ends

summaries.en: An institution keeps and updates a register of all its contractual outsourcing arrangements with at least an identifier, dates, a description of the function and data, its category, the provider's details, the countries of service and of the data, and whether and when the function was assessed as critical or important; for those it also records the group entities using them, the risk assessment and its date, the approving body, the governing law and the audits. It hands the register, whole or in part, to Latvijas Banka on request in a processable electronic format and keeps the information and documents for at least five years after the contract ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Write internal audit's review rights and Latvijas Banka's access and inspection rights into every outsourcing contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 374 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 56., 64. un 65. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Write internal audit's review rights and Latvijas Banka's access and inspection rights into every outsourcing contract

summaries.en: An institution sets out its own and the provider's rights and duties clearly in a written contract, provides in it that its internal audit unit reviews the outsourced functions on a risk basis, and in every outsourcing contract, whether or not the function is critical or important, gives Latvijas Banka the right to access information and to inspect providers in an EU state or elsewhere as the recovery and resolution law and the Credit Institutions Law allow.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Monitor outsourcing providers continuously and keep the data available, intact and secure
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 374 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 76. un 77. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Monitor outsourcing providers continuously and keep the data available, intact and secure

summaries.en: An institution monitors the performance of every outsourcing provider continuously on a risk basis, with particular attention to critical or important functions, ensures the availability, integrity and security of data and information, and supervises and manages its outsourcing with due care, diligence and skill.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a documented and tested exit strategy for every critical or important outsourced function
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 374 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 19.12.2024.), 82. un 83. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a documented and tested exit strategy for every critical or important outsourced function

summaries.en: For a critical or important outsourced function an institution documents an exit strategy that sets the conditions and situations for termination, what it does on the provider's failure or poor performance, the main risks, the analysis, resources and time needed, the staff in charge, the criteria for taking back functions and data and the indicators that trigger the strategy. It develops and, where appropriate, tests the strategy and sets alternative solutions and a transition plan, so that ending a significant outsourcing causes no undue disruption, no breach of its legal duties and no harm to the continuity and quality of its services.

instruments.title: Add Kredītiestādes un ieguldījumu brokeru sabiedrības amatpersonu piemērotības novērtēšanas noteikumi, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 343 of 25 November 2024 on the fit and proper assessment of board members and key function holders
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 343 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under sections 50(2) and 57(1.¹) of the Credit Institutions Law and sections 8(8) and 45(6) of the Investment Firms Law (preamble); entry into force: the passport (Stājas spēkā: 29.11.2024.), the text having no such point

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess each board member and key function holder before they take up the role and keep them suitable throughout
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 343 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 7., 10., 11., 12., 17., 18., 29. un 30. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Assess each board member and key function holder before they take up the role and keep them suitable throughout

summaries.en: A credit institution or investment firm assesses every supervisory or management board member and key function holder before the person starts the duties, requests the information that shows the person meets the requirements, and ensures they remain suitable throughout their term. For board members it assesses reputation, knowledge, skills and experience, the ability to act in line with its values and independently, and the time they can commit, a significant institution also checking the limit on directorships; it identifies its key function holders and reassesses them where doubts arise, for instance after an event or a change of duties.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a suitability assessment policy available to all staff and review its effectiveness every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 343 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 35. un 36. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a suitability assessment policy available to all staff and review its effectiveness every year

summaries.en: A credit institution or investment firm develops a policy for assessing the suitability of its officers that reflects its internal control principles, governance, values, ethics standards and risk strategy, documents every change to it, reviews the effectiveness of its implementation at least once a year and makes it freely available to all its staff.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Induct new board members within a month and train them within six months
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 343 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 94., 95. un 96. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Induct new board members within a month and train them within six months

summaries.en: A credit institution or investment firm keeps a policy and procedures, with adequate resources, for inducting and training new supervisory and management board members in the rules that govern it, its business and risk strategy, organisation and governance and their role, gives them all the information material to their duties within one month of their taking up office and provides training within six months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the boards' individual and collective suitability at least once a year and document the findings
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 343 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 106. un 108. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Assess the boards' individual and collective suitability at least once a year and document the findings

summaries.en: A credit institution or investment firm monitors the individual and collective suitability of its supervisory and management board members, using internal or external resources to evaluate how effectively they work, and assesses their individual and collective suitability regularly and at least once a year, documenting every shortcoming and recommendation and the reasons for any more frequent assessment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an unsuitable person off the board and tell Latvijas Banka within five working days of any unsuitability and the remedy
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 343 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 113., 114. un 115. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep an unsuitable person off the board and tell Latvijas Banka within five working days of any unsuitability and the remedy

summaries.en: Where the initial assessment finds that a person does not meet the requirements for a board seat, the institution ensures the person is not elected or appointed; where the person is already in office or the shortcoming appears in a reassessment, it takes corrective measures to bring the person into line or replace the person. Within five working days it tells Latvijas Banka of any individual or collective unsuitability of a board member found in an assessment and of the corrective measures taken or planned; a shortcoming in reputation, honesty and integrity cannot be remedied.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the financial reporting templates of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3117 the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 282 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 4., 5., 6., 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: File the financial reporting templates of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3117 the regulation lists

summaries.en: A credit institution that is a less significant supervised institution files with Latvijas Banka, individually, the IFRS financial reporting templates of Annex I to Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3117 that the regulation lists, and a Latvian branch of a foreign credit institution the narrower set listed for branches, by the deadlines and at the frequency that implementing regulation sets. Reports go electronically through Latvijas Banka's high-security system with the contact details of the person who prepared them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the number of clients and deposits at the end of each working day by noon the next working day
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 282 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 16. un 18. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Report the number of clients and deposits at the end of each working day by noon the next working day

summaries.en: A credit institution and a Latvian branch of a foreign credit institution report to Latvijas Banka the number of clients, other than monetary financial institutions, and the amount of their deposits on the daily deposits form, as at the end of each working day by 12.00 on the next working day and as at the last day of each month.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report exposures to persons connected with the bank every quarter by the 12th of the second following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 282 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 29., 30., 31. un 37.³ punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Report exposures to persons connected with the bank every quarter by the 12th of the second following month

summaries.en: A credit institution reports its exposures to persons connected with it, measured under Part Four of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 and counting a connected person's guarantee for a client as an indirect exposure, with compliance with the limit calculated against its Tier 1 capital, as at the last day of each calendar quarter by the 12th day of the second month after the quarter. Exposures to registered partners are included where entered into after 1 July 2026.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the complaints received in the year, by type, to Latvijas Banka by 1 February
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 282 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 32. un 33. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Report the complaints received in the year, by type, to Latvijas Banka by 1 February

summaries.en: A credit institution and a Latvian branch of a foreign credit institution report the client complaints they received, by type, on the form in annex 10, as at 31 December, to Latvijas Banka by 1 February of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report operational risk losses of 5,000 euros or more every year by 11 February
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 282 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 10., 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Report operational risk losses of 5,000 euros or more every year by 11 February

summaries.en: A less significant credit institution that is not an other systemically important institution reports its operational risk losses equal to or above 5,000 euros on the templates of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3117, individually or at consolidated level as its supervision requires, as at 31 December, by 11 February of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report funding plans on the EBA templates by 15 March
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 282 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 13., 14. un 15. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 09.06.2026

titles.en: Report funding plans on the EBA templates by 15 March

summaries.en: A less significant credit institution reports its funding plans on the templates and instructions of EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2019/05, individually or at consolidated level as its supervision requires, as at 31 December, by 15 March of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt a complaints procedure approved by the management board and name a person responsible for it
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 358 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 6., 7., 8., 9. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Adopt a complaints procedure approved by the management board and name a person responsible for it

summaries.en: A financial market participant develops and applies a complaints procedure suited to its kind, size and organisation that ensures a quick, equal, fair and effective process, covering at least the persons responsible, the process and deadlines, ways to complain free of charge, answering, registering, fact-checking, conflicts of interest, data protection and internal reporting of shortcomings. Its management body approves the procedure and controls its application, it appoints a responsible person to oversee the process, and the procedure is made known to every employee involved.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell clients before and during the service how to complain and acknowledge electronic complaints at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 358 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 11., 12. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell clients before and during the service how to complain and acknowledge electronic complaints at once

summaries.en: A financial market participant gives clients and prospective clients, before or during the service, in the contract, at its premises or on its website, information on what a complaint must contain, where and how to file it, the process and deadlines, its supervisor and other ways to resolve complaints and disputes. When it receives a complaint electronically it acknowledges receipt at once and explains the process, and gives further information on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check the facts of each complaint and answer in plain language, naming other routes if the answer does not satisfy
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 358 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 14., 15., 16. un 17. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Check the facts of each complaint and answer in plain language, naming other routes if the answer does not satisfy

summaries.en: A financial market participant checks the evidence and information connected with a complaint within its powers and answers in good time, clearly and with reasons, in plain language, after checking them. If it cannot answer within the legal deadline for objective reasons it tells the complainant why and when it will, and where its answer does not fully meet the complainant's demands it tells the complainant of the other ways to pursue the complaint.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register every complaint by the next working day and every answer on the day it is prepared
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 358 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 19., 20., 21. un 22. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Register every complaint by the next working day and every answer on the day it is prepared

summaries.en: A financial market participant keeps a single register of the complaints it receives and its answers, recording a complaint no later than the next working day and the answer on the day it is prepared, with the complainant's identity and contact details, the dates, the substance and reason, the actions taken and when, and its own view of whether the complaint was justified, and keeps the information as its archiving rules require.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Analyse complaints for recurring causes and have the responsible person report on the process every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 358 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 18., 23., 24. un 25. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Analyse complaints for recurring causes and have the responsible person report on the process every year

summaries.en: A financial market participant analyses complaints to find and resolve recurring or systemic problems and legal and operational risks, considering whether the causes affect other processes, products or services. At least once a year the responsible person reports to the management body on the process's compliance and effectiveness, the analysis and the causes, and after that review the participant takes measures to remove the causes found. It gives Latvijas Banka information on its complaints and those measures on request.

instruments.title: Add Klienta riska noteikšanas, klienta izpētes un klienta padziļinātas izpētes prasības, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 316 of 17 September 2024 on customer risk scoring, due diligence, enhanced due diligence and the IT systems for AML and sanctions risk
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under sections 7(1.¹), 21.¹(2), 22(4), 26(7) and 47(2) of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing and section 13(4)(3) of the sanctions law (preamble); entry into force: the passport (Stājas spēkā: 20.09.2024.), the text having no such point

titles.en: Requirements for customer risk assessment, customer due diligence, enhanced customer due diligence and information technology solutions in managing money laundering, terrorism and proliferation financing and sanctions risks

payload.shortName: Klienta riska noteikšanas, klienta izpētes un klienta padziļinātas izpētes prasības

obligations.title: Add the duty: Score each customer's risk with a documented method, automated in a bank, and keep the weights up to date
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 5., 6., 8., 9., 10., 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Score each customer's risk with a documented method, automated in a bank, and keep the weights up to date

summaries.en: A financial market participant builds a customer risk scoring system, or where its business model allows sets risk-increasing factors in its internal rules, drawing on the factors of the law and EU acts, the national and EU risk assessments, the EBA risk factor guidelines and published typologies. Each factor carries points, the sum is the customer's score, and the customer is rescored when due diligence shows a change in risk; the weights are reviewed regularly and the review documented. A credit institution, licensed payment or e-money institution or investment firm calculates the score automatically unless Latvijas Banka has agreed in writing to an exception.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Scale due diligence, its refresh cycle and service limits to the customer's risk
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 4., 7., 13., 14., 18. un 20. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Scale due diligence, its refresh cycle and service limits to the customer's risk

summaries.en: A financial market participant sets in its internal rules the requirements, frequency and scope of due diligence, enhanced due diligence and transaction monitoring, and documents why the measures fit the customer's risks. On the basis of the customer's risk it sets how often and in how much depth customer information is refreshed, gathers enough information to identify and manage risk-increasing factors, sets reasonable limits on services or products when a relationship starts or an occasional transaction is made, and examines the customer's services and products as a whole.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence at set thresholds, repeat it periodically and finish it within a justified deadline
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 22., 23., 24., 25. un 27. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence at set thresholds, repeat it periodically and finish it within a justified deadline

summaries.en: A financial market participant applies enhanced due diligence at least where the anti-money-laundering rules require it, where the customer's risk score reaches the threshold it sets or where its internal risk-increasing factors are found before an occasional transaction. It sets the score threshold or other circumstances that trigger enhanced due diligence and a risk-based period after which it is repeated, covering the transactions of that period, sets and justifies the deadline for completing it, and may extend the deadline only for objective reasons in a documented decision, applying risk-mitigating measures such as enhanced monitoring meanwhile.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain evidence of the real business of a legal person that may be a shell arrangement
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 17. un 21. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Obtain evidence of the real business of a legal person that may be a shell arrangement

summaries.en: A credit institution, payment or e-money institution, investment firm, and for portfolio management and fund distribution a management company, obtains and assesses, on a risk basis, information on the business and economic value of a legal person customer that may show the first feature of a shell arrangement under the anti-money-laundering law: documents explaining its business model, an audited annual report, evidence of the real flow of goods and services, of its main business partners' actual business, of the taxes it pays and of the people engaged to run its business. Such a firm is able to retrieve information on its customers that are shell arrangements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put customers under enhanced due diligence on enhanced monitoring suited to their risk
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 36., 37. un 38. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Put customers under enhanced due diligence on enhanced monitoring suited to their risk

summaries.en: For a customer under enhanced due diligence a financial market participant decides, on the customer's risk profile, whether to apply enhanced monitoring, which means one or more of: executing transactions only after receiving and assessing documents that support them, executing them only with the approval of an authorised employee or senior officer, setting limits or other restrictions on further services, setting criteria that trigger a review of transactions, and monitoring transactions online before execution. It may keep enhanced monitoring until it has the information it needs, decides to end the relationship or the account is actually closed, or for the whole relationship.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out enhanced due diligence on a respondent before and during a correspondent relationship
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 39., 40., 41. un 42. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Carry out enhanced due diligence on a respondent before and during a correspondent relationship

summaries.en: Before a correspondent relationship starts, and during it, a financial market participant applies to the respondent, on a risk basis, one or more enhanced measures: it assesses the respondent's own anti-money-laundering and sanctions rules against the list the regulation gives, the ban on shell banks and anonymous accounts included, checks that its IT systems fit its risk profile, identifies its branches and related companies whose clients will use the services, reviews its annual report, obtains the risk assessment of a respondent from a third country and plans how to manage that risk, and checks that its internal controls work. In monitoring it checks that the respondent's clients' transactions match what was known and that the respondent has established its clients' source of funds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run automated customer and payment screening against sanctions and PEP lists, daily at least, and scenario-based monitoring
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 316 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 43., 44. un 45. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Run automated customer and payment screening against sanctions and PEP lists, daily at least, and scenario-based monitoring

summaries.en: A credit institution provides automated IT solutions that hold customer data with mandatory fields and history and warn when information needs refreshing, calculate the customer risk score and flag enhanced due diligence, control the deadlines of enhanced due diligence, monitor transactions with scenarios for suspicious activity and sanctions risk, screen payment information, the purpose included, against sanctions lists and stop or block a payment on a match, and screen customers, beneficial owners, authorised persons and members against sanctions, PEP and internal adverse lists before the relationship and at least once a day during it. The systems keep audit trails and access levels, and the institution tests their effectiveness regularly, documents the tests and improves the systems where needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the money laundering risk of a new service, a material change or a new client group before starting
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 359 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 4., 5. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Assess the money laundering risk of a new service, a material change or a new client group before starting

summaries.en: Before introducing a new financial service, materially changing how one is provided or offering one to a new target group of clients, a financial market participant assesses the money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risk of the services, clients and countries involved and whether new or amended policies and procedures are needed. It regularly evaluates and remedies the shortcomings found in its risk management internal control system and applies every measure in full to all clients, related persons included.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the supervisory board oversee and the management board run money laundering risk management with the tasks the regulation sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 359 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 8., 9., 10., 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Have the supervisory board oversee and the management board run money laundering risk management with the tasks the regulation sets

summaries.en: The supervisory board oversees how management handles money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risk, has internal audit check the internal control system regularly, sets how it is informed, and approves the risk strategy and its changes. The management board reviews and updates the risk assessment, ensures policies and procedures exist and are followed, allocates responsibility, staffs the function with qualified people, prevents conflicts of interest that raise the risk and approves corrective measures. In a credit institution the supervisory board also approves the strategy's implementing policies, sets a remuneration policy that rewards no short-term income from higher-risk business and keeps risk control staff's pay independent of results, and reviews the strategy at least once a year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set in internal rules how the money laundering compliance officers inform the boards and escalate material shortcomings
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 359 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 14. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Set in internal rules how the money laundering compliance officers inform the boards and escalate material shortcomings

summaries.en: When it names the management board member who oversees anti-money-laundering compliance and appoints the officers responsible for it, a financial market participant sets in its internal rules the regular and ad hoc informing of the supervisory and management boards about money laundering risk management, the division of duties for carrying out and adjusting risk measures, and reporting to management when material shortcomings or non-compliance are found. A credit institution also covers reporting on the risk strategy and its exposure and on deviations from the strategy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt a money laundering risk strategy with exposure limits and send it to Latvijas Banka within a month of approval
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 359 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 3., 15., 16., 17., 18. un 20. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Adopt a money laundering risk strategy with exposure limits and send it to Latvijas Banka within a month of approval

summaries.en: A credit institution draws up and carries out, individually and at group level, a money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risk strategy that sets the maximum limits of the exposure indicators it is willing and able to take on, among them the share of high-risk clients and of the income earned from them, according to its capacity to manage the risk and the resources available. It sends the strategy to Latvijas Banka within one calendar month of its approval by the supervisory board. Another participant with higher risk keeps such a strategy to the extent its business requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess every breach of a money laundering exposure limit and report a breach of 10 per cent or more to Latvijas Banka
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 359 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 21. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Assess every breach of a money laundering exposure limit and report a breach of 10 per cent or more to Latvijas Banka

summaries.en: A credit institution's management board regularly checks whether the exposure limits set in the strategy are exceeded or the rules for setting them breached and assesses the reasons and whether a breach is justified. Where a limit is exceeded by 10 per cent or more, the institution sends Latvijas Banka a report on it each time together with its quarterly exposure report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the quarterly money laundering risk exposure report with Latvijas Banka by the end of the following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. decembra noteikumi Nr. 359 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 237, 05.12.2024.), 22., 24., 25. un 26. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File the quarterly money laundering risk exposure report with Latvijas Banka by the end of the following month

summaries.en: A Latvian credit institution, and a Latvian branch of a credit institution of another Member State or a third country, sets how it collects and assesses its money laundering risk exposure indicators and prepares a report on its exposure for each quarter on the forms in the annex, filing it electronically through Latvijas Banka's high-security system by the last day of the month after the quarter. A branch files only parts 1 and 4 of the report and leaves out the strategy limits.

instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 278 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 47(2)(3) of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (preamble); entry into force: point 27 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2024. gada 1. jūlijā) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 01.07.2024.)

titles.en: Regulations on staffing the management of money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risks and on staff training requirements

obligations.title: Add the duty: Size and qualify anti-money-laundering staff to the business, its risk and the workload, and cover absences
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 278 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 2., 3., 4., 5. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Size and qualify anti-money-laundering staff to the business, its risk and the workload, and cover absences

summaries.en: A financial market participant provides the staff needed to manage its money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risks, judged at least by its business and risk level, the effectiveness of its internal controls, its automated systems, its staff's workload and their qualifications. It measures workload by the clients and transactions each employee handles, the number of clients needing due diligence or enhanced due diligence, the cases with suspicious indicators to analyse and, where it has correspondent relationships, the correspondents' requests, sets the qualification each role needs and ensures that staff can be replaced when absent.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt a documented anti-money-laundering training plan approved by senior management and review it every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 278 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 7., 8., 9., 10. un 14. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Adopt a documented anti-money-laundering training plan approved by senior management and review it every year

summaries.en: A financial market participant sets in its internal rules which categories of staff receive anti-money-laundering training and documents a training plan, approved by senior management, with internal, external, new-starter and extraordinary programmes suited to each role. It updates the programmes when internal or external rules change and assesses their adequacy and effectiveness at least once a year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Train staff internally and externally at least once a year and test their knowledge
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 278 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 11., 15., 19., 20. un 25. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Train staff internally and externally at least once a year and test their knowledge

summaries.en: A financial market participant provides internal and external training at least once a year, covering at least the anti-money-laundering rules and their application, liability for breaches, published examples of poor practice and their sanctions, its own good and poor practice, its risk exposure and customer due diligence, and gives external training at least once a year to the senior manager responsible for anti-money-laundering, the compliance officer and the internal auditors who audit the area. It tests staff knowledge after internal, new-starter and extraordinary training, and gives extraordinary training to an employee who breaches the rules through lack of knowledge.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Train new staff when they start and have an experienced colleague supervise them until then
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 278 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 21., 22. un 23. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Train new staff when they start and have an experienced colleague supervise them until then

summaries.en: A financial market participant trains staff who start or change role when they begin, covering the internal training topics their role needs, and until that training is done has an experienced employee who has completed internal training and passed the test supervise their work, documenting who that supervisor is.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record each training and keep the records for five years after the employee leaves
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 278 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 12. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Record each training and keep the records for five years after the employee leaves

summaries.en: A financial market participant records for each training its name, the trainee's personal data, position and unit, the place, the trainer and organiser, the time and duration, the test result and any certificate, and the materials used, and keeps these records and those on supervisors of new staff for five years from the day the employee's employment ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Justify and risk-assess each agent arrangement, have senior management approve it and refuse unsuitable agents
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 351 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 4., 5., 6. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Justify and risk-assess each agent arrangement, have senior management approve it and refuse unsuitable agents

summaries.en: Before using an agent to identify customers or gather due diligence information, a financial market participant assesses, justifies and documents the need, sets the countries where the agent will work, assesses the risks and plans measures to reduce them, and its senior management approves the cooperation on a risk assessment. It does not use an agent where the agent, its beneficial owner or representative is under sanctions, has a doubtful reputation or is a person, or connected with a person, whose transactions it has reported as suspicious. It remains responsible for the identification and due diligence done through the agent.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Bind agents to the conditions the regulation sets and keep a policy and procedures for using them
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 351 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 8., 9. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Bind agents to the conditions the regulation sets and keep a policy and procedures for using them

summaries.en: A financial market participant using an agent checks that the agent's identification and information meet the rules, forbids the agent to subcontract, requires the agent to report at once any risk-increasing factor of a customer, any end of a representative's engagement and any breach of anti-money-laundering rules, and lets a legal-person agent's representatives work only after it has assessed them and consented in writing. It keeps a policy and procedures setting the countries, customer types and activities covered, risk-mitigating measures, criteria for agents and representatives, uniform contract terms, conflicts of interest, quality reviews and how cooperation is widened, limited or ended.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Train agents at least once a year and review the quality of their work every year for senior management
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 351 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 13., 15., 16., 20., 21., 24. un 25. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Train agents at least once a year and review the quality of their work every year for senior management

summaries.en: A financial market participant trains its agents and their representatives in its anti-money-laundering requirements when they start and at least once a year, tests their knowledge and documents the training, and keeps the programme up to date. It keeps an agent register, reviews the compliance and quality of each agent's services at least once a year, checks agents and their representatives and beneficial owners against sanctions, and documents and gives senior management at least once a year an assessment of the agents' quality and their effect on its risk exposure, on which senior management decides further cooperation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Decide and document whether to accept a customer before the agent may tell the customer
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 351 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 26., 27., 28. un 29. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Decide and document whether to accept a customer before the agent may tell the customer

summaries.en: A financial market participant assesses the risks of a customer identified or researched through an agent and sets controls to identify and manage them in time. The agent may tell the customer of the decision only after the participant has taken and documented its decision to start or refuse the relationship, and where the customer's information falls short of its policies the participant rejects the documents, asking the agent for compliant ones, or refuses the relationship. It is able to retrieve the customers onboarded or refused through agents and the reason for any refusal.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base the sanctions risk assessment on the listed factors and update it at least every 12 months
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 277 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 2., 4., 5. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.07.2026

titles.en: Base the sanctions risk assessment on the listed factors and update it at least every 12 months

summaries.en: In its sanctions risk assessment a financial market participant weighs at least its own regions, agents, services and products, the customer, country, product and channel risks, and for the sanctions of a NATO member state that materially affect it, the settlement currencies, correspondent and other contractual links, its regions and its customers' countries; in building controls it weighs the higher-risk indicators the regulation lists, such as links with sanctioned territories or their borders, military or dual-use goods, front or shelf companies, and pricing, routing or documents that do not fit. It updates the assessment at least every three years, and a credit institution, licensed payment or e-money institution, investment firm or crypto-asset service provider at least every 12 months.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Build the sanctions internal control system with the policies, screening and procedures the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 277 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 3. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.07.2026

titles.en: Build the sanctions internal control system with the policies, screening and procedures the regulation lists

summaries.en: A financial market participant's sanctions internal control system, approved by senior management and following group-wide policy where it is in a group, provides at least for policies reviewed when rules, regimes or the business change, a method to assess customer and transaction risk, measures to carry out sanctions and limit services where needed, screening of customers, beneficial owners, authorised persons, members and transactions against sanctions lists with a procedure for matches whose effectiveness it can prove, detection and investigation of possible breaches before and during relationships, decisions on higher-risk customers, reporting to management and to the Financial Intelligence Unit, anonymous internal reporting where its size allows, IT support with regular testing, and management of outsourcing risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Evaluate the effectiveness of the sanctions internal control system at least every 18 months and act on triggers
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 277 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 8. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.07.2026

titles.en: Evaluate the effectiveness of the sanctions internal control system at least every 18 months and act on triggers

summaries.en: A financial market participant evaluates and documents the effectiveness of its sanctions internal control system at least every 18 months, reviewing the risk of its customers, their countries, partners, products, channels and transactions, and improves the system and its policies where needed, an independent evaluation by a professional external assessor included as the anti-money-laundering law and Latvijas Banka's rules require. It also reassesses the risk and improves the system whenever it or Latvijas Banka finds shortcomings, when it plans changes that raise its sanctions risk, or when material changes in sanctions, such as new sanctions, may affect it or its customers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a sanctions officer with decision powers and notify Latvijas Banka within 30 days of an appointment or replacement
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 277 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.07.2026

titles.en: Appoint a sanctions officer with decision powers and notify Latvijas Banka within 30 days of an appointment or replacement

summaries.en: A financial market participant appoints an employee responsible for sanctions risk management who may take decisions and answers directly for compliance with sanctions law and for reporting breaches or attempted breaches to the Financial Intelligence Unit and senior management. Senior management gives the system adequate resources, keeps it functionally independent of the business and gives the officer the powers and access to information needed. Within 30 days of appointing or replacing the officer the participant tells Latvijas Banka in writing the officer's name, personal code, position, date of appointment, email and telephone.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make sure sanctions staff know the applicable sanctions law and train them regularly
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. marta noteikumi Nr. 277 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 62, 27.03.2024.), 13. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 15.07.2026

titles.en: Make sure sanctions staff know the applicable sanctions law and train them regularly

summaries.en: A financial market participant ensures that the staff involved in sanctions risk management, the responsible officer included, know the risks involved and the sanctions law of Latvia, the European Union and the NATO member states whose sanctions materially affect it or the financial market, and trains them regularly to improve their knowledge and skills.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess and document that staff who advise on or inform about investments have the required qualification and experience
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. augusta noteikumi Nr. 311 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 168, 29.08.2024.), 2., 3., 5., 6., 7., 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Assess and document that staff who advise on or inform about investments have the required qualification and experience

summaries.en: A firm ensures that the staff who give investment advice or information on investment products and services have the knowledge and competence their duties require, keeps the duties of advisers clearly separate from those of staff who only inform, and assesses and documents whether each person has an appropriate qualification, obtained externally or in an internal programme covering the topics the regulation lists, and appropriate experience: at least six months of successfully giving information or 12 months of successfully giving advice, the latter shortened by at most six months where the firm justifies the person's skills.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let staff without the qualification or experience serve clients only under a qualified supervisor for at most four years

titles.en: Let staff without the qualification or experience serve clients only under a qualified supervisor for at most four years

summaries.en: An employee without the appropriate qualification or experience may give investment advice or information only under the supervision of a qualified and experienced colleague with enough time to supervise, for no longer than four years from starting, or a shorter period Latvijas Banka sets. The firm sets the level and intensity of supervision according to the person's qualification and experience and the services, and the supervisor answers for the advice or information given, and for the suitability report, as for their own.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Review staff development needs every year and train staff before any new investment product is introduced
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. augusta noteikumi Nr. 311 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 168, 29.08.2024.), 13. un 14. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Review staff development needs every year and train staff before any new investment product is introduced

summaries.en: At least once a year a firm reviews, internally or externally, the development and experience needs of its advisers and informing staff, changes in the rules included, and documents the review, so that qualifications stay adequate and knowledge improves, with special training before any new investment product is introduced. The compliance officer monitors and evaluates compliance with the regulation and reports the results and shortcomings to the management body.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give Latvijas Banka on request the evidence of each adviser's experience and qualification
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. augusta noteikumi Nr. 311 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 168, 29.08.2024.), 15. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Give Latvijas Banka on request the evidence of each adviser's experience and qualification

summaries.en: On request a firm gives Latvijas Banka information on its staff's knowledge and competence with the documents that show compliance, at least the data on the staff who advise or inform, the length of their relevant experience and any assessment of skills used to shorten it, and their qualifications with the dates certificates were obtained and renewed.

titles.en: Apply section 5 of ESMA's MiFID II product governance guidelines in manufacturing and distributing investment products

summaries.en: To meet the product governance requirements of chapter XII.⁵ of the Financial Instrument Market Law, an investment firm or credit institution that provides investment services, or sells or advises on structured deposits, and a management company or external alternative fund manager that provides portfolio management, follows the requirements of section 5 of ESMA's guidelines ESMA35-43-3448 of 3 August 2023 on MiFID II product governance requirements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the client the full price, costs and risks of a package and of each of its parts, in good time and plain language
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 21. augusta noteikumi Nr. 246 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 162, 23.08.2023.), 4., 5., 6., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Give the client the full price, costs and risks of a package and of each of its parts, in good time and plain language

summaries.en: A firm that provides an investment service as part of a package or on condition of another product gives the client complete information on the price of the package and of each component, with all related costs and risks, in good time before the client is bound, in plain and understandable language and in a way that does not mislead about the real costs or prevent comparison. When it advertises a component it shows the components' prices and costs equally prominently, gives a clear summary of all known material costs such as administration, transaction costs and early termination penalties, and discloses the main non-price factors and the risks of combining the products just as prominently.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Say whether the parts of a package can be bought separately and use no pre-ticked boxes
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 21. augusta noteikumi Nr. 246 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 162, 23.08.2023.), 9. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Say whether the parts of a package can be bought separately and use no pre-ticked boxes

summaries.en: A firm tells the client unambiguously whether the components of a package can be bought separately or whether one must be bought to obtain another, makes sure the way the package is sold lets the client make an informed choice between a component and the package, and uses no pre-ticked boxes, online or in any other sales document, where one product is automatically tied to another.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a component's withdrawal right inside a package and let the client split the package without a disproportionate penalty
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 21. augusta noteikumi Nr. 246 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 162, 23.08.2023.), 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a component's withdrawal right inside a package and let the client split the package without a disproportionate penalty

summaries.en: Where a component of a package carries a right of withdrawal for a set period on its own, the firm gives the same right for that component when it is sold in the package, and after the purchase it lets the client split the products combined in the offer without a disproportionate penalty, unless there is a justified reason why that is not possible.

obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2022. gada 13. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 208 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 117, 17.06.2022.), 9., 10., 11., 12. un 21. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File payment statistics every half year by 25 July and 25 January and every quarter by the 20th of the following month

summaries.en: A payment service provider prepares half-yearly statistical data on its customers' payments on the form in annex 1 and files them with Latvijas Banka by 25 July and 25 January, and quarterly data on the form in annex 2 by 20 April, 20 July, 20 October and 20 January, or the shortened half-yearly report where Latvijas Banka has allowed reduced reporting. It includes payments its agents in other countries handled for it, keeps the half-yearly data consistent with the quarterly data and with its card payment statistics, and files electronically, credit institutions and their branches through the high-security system.

titles.en: Report separately the payments authenticated with strong customer authentication and those exempted from it

summaries.en: A payment service provider reports payments as authenticated with strong customer authentication where the requirement of section 104.⁴ of the Law on Payment Services and Electronic Money applied to them, and as authenticated without it where an exemption under the seventh paragraph of that section applied, and codes each payment as initiated remotely or not.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report every executed fraudulent payment by type and origin, with the losses by who bore them
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2022. gada 13. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 208 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 117, 17.06.2022.), 24., 25., 26., 27., 28., 56. un 57. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report every executed fraudulent payment by type and origin, with the losses by who bore them

summaries.en: A payment service provider reports all executed fraudulent payments, those detected and still under investigation included, attributing each to the period in which it was executed: unauthorised payments, whether issued by a fraudster with stolen data or altered in transit or in the provider's systems, and payments the payer made because a third party manipulated the payer, payments initiated through a payment initiation service included. Payments blocked before execution are left out. Where it reports fraudulent payments it also reports, for each payment type, the losses caused by fraud split between itself, the payment service user and others.
